newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Halla in Oman iron plant joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Halla in Oman iron plant joint venture.

text.p: South Korea's Halla Engineering and Construction Corp said on Monday it had signed a letter of intent with Oman's Bahwan Group to build a hot briquetted iron plant in Oman.
Halla will hold a 51 percent stake in the venture and the Bahwan Group will hold the remainder, a company statement said.
Construction of the plant, which will have an annual capacity of two million tonnes, is due to begin in late 1997, the statement said.
Details, including the size of investment, will be decided later, it said.
Hot briquetted iron is a low-cost substitue of scrap iron.
